why: The count npm run conformance reports today. It is a ratchet, not a target: this number may fall and may not rise, per CLAUDE.md Session Discipline, and there is no exception. layout-manifests has an implementation since ADR-015, so a new screen is a manifest, not a new failure.

standing.layout-manifests: one per route whose page does not render through a layout manifest. The format and the list–detail renderer exist (ADR-015); the check reads each page.tsx, so a route clears only by being converted
standing.mock-banner: three screens read from fixtures without saying so
standing.generated-client-only: api-client.ts is the hand-written transport the rule is about
standing.tokens-only: raw values that predate the token layer
